I posted this a while ago in a different sub and I would like to restate what I originally said there:

The Ukiyo-e depiction of clouds and waves has always enraptured me; there is something about this particular style which I love deeply and truly feel captures the dream like perfection of Hokusai's world in paint. The spinning turbulence of the water, the claw like fingers of the wave reaching out to touch the sky, the mesmerizing central vortex moving from light to dark, all work to classify this print above the rest in terms of depicting the turmoil and restlessness of the ocean; the emotion in the print, coupled with the play of deep and light blues works to create a deep longing for the sea in my heart. I love the ocean and I believe this print was made by a man who felt the same.
